requiredCorrections.title: Current asset supply cannot be constructed through the closed selector grammar
requiredCorrections.finding: IssuancePolicyInput.supply is UInt128 bound to current asset supply. Supply stores imported, issued and burned separately. Their checked aggregate has no generated context field. Selectors cannot perform arithmetic or aggregation, and the rule body cannot read the omitted components from state.

A constant110 fails after the next mint5, when the required input becomes115. Binding issued20 instead changes the meaning of a supply-cap policy; with cap112 and mint5 it would test25 instead of115.
requiredCorrections.requiredChange: Define a concrete typed binding site for checked current represented supply, or bind the exact Supply components through an appropriate closed signature and compute the total in the rule. Include consecutive mint/burn states with nonzero imported, issued and burned components.

requiredCorrections.title: PositionClose does not reconcile its final funding/P&L calculation with residual Duties
requiredCorrections.finding: PositionClosed applies the computed close deltas to metrics. PositionMarkDuty is specified for PositionAdjust and omitted from PositionClose's update roles. The close contract neither requires zero funding/P&L deltas nor supplies another final-mark Duty construction. It then makes the existing Duty authoritative for terminal payment or assignment.
requiredCorrections.witness: An Active position has P&L+7 and a matching unpaid Duty7. An admitted closing calculation returns pnlDelta+5 while satisfying the required zero final margin, liquidity and notional. The closed metric becomes12, but the residual map sees Duty7. Carrying or paying7 completes the stated residual partition while omitting the additional5 calculated at closure. A sign-changing close similarly lacks the required party reversal.
requiredCorrections.requiredChange: Reconcile final funding/P&L amounts and parties before setting Closed and processing the residual map. Alternatively, explicitly require zero funding/P&L close deltas and an earlier PositionAdjust for final marking. Preserve the subsequent distinction between closed historical metrics and later assigned or paid residual Duties.
